original_interpretation: China's Export Control Law took effect on 1 December 2020.
evidence_found: "第四十九条 本法自2020年12月1日起施行。" and Presidential Order No. 58: "…于2020年10月17日通过，现予公布，自2020年12月1日起施行。" (MOFCOM full text, Art. 49)
notes: The MOFCOM page metadata shows 生效日期 2020-10-19 (posting date), but the statute text itself gives 1 Dec 2020. legislation/fact classification fine.

original_interpretation: ECL Art. 9: temporary controls on unlisted items, max two years, then evaluate and cancel, extend or list.
evidence_found: "…可以对出口管制清单以外的货物、技术和服务实施临时管制，并予以公告。临时管制的实施期限不超过二年。临时管制实施期限届满前应当及时进行评估，根据评估结果决定取消临时管制、延长临时管制或者将临时管制物项列入出口管制清单。" (Art. 9 para 2); CLT Art. 9: "A temporary control can be enforced for a term of up to two years."
notes: Requires State Council (or State Council + CMC) approval. Decree No. 792 Art. 12 later adds that each period is up to 2 years and extension is limited to 2 times (new claim added in this batch).

original_interpretation: ECL Art. 10 allows outright export bans or bans to specific countries/organisations/individuals with State Council (and CMC) approval.
evidence_found: "第十条 …经国务院批准，或者经国务院、中央军事委员会批准，国家出口管制管理部门会同有关部门可以禁止相关管制物项的出口，或者禁止相关管制物项向特定目的国家和地区、特定组织和个人出口。" (Art. 10)
notes: Bans apply to controlled items (管制物项), as the claim says.

original_interpretation: ECL Art. 12 catch-all licence requirement for unlisted items where exporter knows/should know/is notified of risks to national security, WMD or terrorism.
evidence_found: "出口管制清单所列管制物项以及临时管制物项之外的货物、技术和服务，出口经营者知道或者应当知道，或者得到国家出口管制管理部门通知，相关货物、技术和服务可能存在以下风险的，应当向国家出口管制管理部门申请许可：（一）危害国家安全和利益；（二）被用于设计、开发、生产或者使用大规模杀伤性武器及其运载工具；（三）被用于恐怖主义目的。" (Art. 12 para 3)

original_interpretation: ECL Art. 18 control list of importers/end users; exporters may not trade with them without special approval.
evidence_found: "国家出口管制管理部门对有下列情形之一的进口商和最终用户，建立管控名单：（一）违反最终用户或者最终用途管理要求的；（二）可能危害国家安全和利益的；（三）将管制物项用于恐怖主义目的的。…出口经营者在特殊情况下确需与列入管控名单的进口商、最终用户进行交易的，可以向国家出口管制管理部门提出申请。" (Art. 18)
notes: Text says exporters 'may apply' in special circumstances; 'special approval' is a fair paraphrase. Removal from the list on application is also provided.

original_interpretation: ECL Art. 34 fines for unlicensed export: 5-10x illegal turnover if >= RMB 500k; RMB 0.5-5 m if below/no turnover.
evidence_found: "第三十四条 …（一）未经许可擅自出口管制物项…违法经营额五十万元以上的，并处违法经营额五倍以上十倍以下罚款；没有违法经营额或者违法经营额不足五十万元的，并处五十万元以上五百万元以下罚款" (Art. 34)
notes: Threshold is 'RMB 500,000 or more' (五十万元以上); the lower band also covers cases with no illegal turnover. Art. 34 also covers exceeding licence scope and exporting prohibited items; serious cases add suspension/revocation of export qualification. Metric value 0.5 CNY m minimum is correct.

original_interpretation: ECL Art. 44 extends liability to organisations/individuals outside China that violate its export control provisions and endanger China's national security and interests.
evidence_found: "第四十四条 中华人民共和国境外的组织和个人，违反本法有关出口管制管理规定，危害中华人民共和国国家安全和利益，妨碍履行防扩散等国际义务的，依法处理并追究其法律责任。" (Art. 44)
notes: The article also lists 'hindering performance of non-proliferation and other international obligations' (CLT renders the clauses as cumulative with '[and]'); the claim omits that element.

original_interpretation: ECL Art. 45 applies the law to transit, transshipment and re-export.
evidence_found: "第四十五条 管制物项的过境、转运、通运、再出口或者从保税区、出口加工区等海关特殊监管区域和出口监管仓库、保税物流中心等保税监管场所向境外出口，依照本法的有关规定执行。" (Art. 45)
notes: Also covers exports from bonded/special customs zones.

original_interpretation: ECL Art. 48 authorises reciprocal measures against countries abusing export controls.
evidence_found: "第四十八条 任何国家或者地区滥用出口管制措施危害中华人民共和国国家安全和利益的，中华人民共和国可以根据实际情况对该国家或者地区对等采取措施。" (Art. 48)

original_interpretation: Decree No. 792 promulgated 30 Sept 2024, effective 1 Dec 2024, replacing four earlier dual-use regulations.
evidence_found: "《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》已经2024年9月18日国务院第41次常务会议通过，现予公布，自2024年12月1日起施行。总理 李强 2024年9月30日"; Art. 50: "…《核两用品及相关技术出口管制条例》、《导弹及相关物项和技术出口管制条例》、《生物两用品及相关设备和技术出口管制条例》和《有关化学品及相关设备和技术出口管制办法》同时废止。"
notes: Adopted 18 Sept 2024 at the State Council executive meeting; signed/promulgated 30 Sept 2024 (State Council Gazette 2024 No. 31).

original_interpretation: Decree 792 licence routes: single licence <=1 year, general licence <=3 years, export voucher by registration.
evidence_found: Art. 15: "出口两用物项应当…获得单项许可、通用许可，或者以登记填报信息方式获得出口凭证。…单项许可的有效期不超过1年…通用许可的有效期不超过3年。"
notes: Single licence = one export to a single end user; general licence = multiple exports to one or more end users; voucher route limited to Art. 19 cases (repairs, exhibitions, civil aircraft parts etc.).

original_interpretation: Decree 792: 45 working-day decision; State Council-escalated cases not bound; expert review/on-site checks excluded from the clock.
evidence_found: Art. 17: "…在45个工作日内作出准予或者不予许可的决定。…需要报国务院批准，或者报国务院、中央军事委员会批准的，不受前款规定出口许可审查期限的限制。…组织鉴别，征询专家意见，或者对出口经营者、最终用户进行实地核查的，所需时间不计算在本条第一款规定的出口许可审查期限内。"
notes: Art. 26 also lifts the 45-day limit for exports to watch-list (关注名单) parties.

original_interpretation: Decree 792: MOFCOM control list; may prohibit/restrict/suspend transactions; exporters need approval to trade with listed parties.
evidence_found: Art. 29: "（一）禁止有关两用物项交易；（二）限制有关两用物项交易；（三）责令中止有关两用物项出口；（四）其他必要的措施。…特殊情况下确需进行有关交易的，出口经营者应当向国务院商务主管部门提出申请，经批准后可以与该进口商、最终用户进行相应的交易并按要求报告。"

original_interpretation: Decree 792 Art. 49 extraterritorial reach over foreign-made items containing/made with specified Chinese-origin items/technology.
evidence_found: Art. 49: "境外组织和个人在中华人民共和国境外向特定目的国家和地区、特定组织和个人转移、提供下列货物、技术和服务，国务院商务主管部门可以要求相关经营者参照本条例有关规定执行：（一）含有、集成或者混有原产于中华人民共和国的特定两用物项在境外制造的两用物项；（二）使用原产于中华人民共和国的特定技术等两用物项在境外制造的两用物项；（三）原产于中华人民共和国的特定两用物项。"
notes: Wording is 'may require ... to apply mutatis mutandis (参照)'. A third limb covers re-transfer of Chinese-origin items themselves.

original_interpretation: Unreliable Entity List rules (MOFCOM Order 2020 No. 4) effective 19 Sept 2020; targets foreign entities endangering sovereignty/security/development or breaking market principles by cutting off transactions/discriminating.
evidence_found: "（2020年9月19日商务部令第4号公布 自2020年9月19日起施行）"; Art. 2: "（一）危害中国国家主权、安全、发展利益；（二）违反正常的市场交易原则，中断与中国企业、其他组织或者个人的正常交易，或者对中国企业、其他组织或者个人采取歧视性措施，严重损害中国企业、其他组织或者个人合法权益。"
notes: Limb (2) also requires 'seriously harming the legitimate rights and interests' of Chinese parties, which the claim omits.

original_interpretation: UEL listed entities can be restricted/banned from China-related import/export and investment, staff entry/work permits restricted, and fined.
evidence_found: Art. 10: "（一）限制或者禁止其从事与中国有关的进出口活动；（二）限制或者禁止其在中国境内投资；（三）限制或者禁止其相关人员、交通运输工具等入境；（四）限制或者取消其相关人员在中国境内工作许可、停留或者居留资格；（五）根据情节轻重给予相应数额的罚款；（六）其他必要的措施。"
notes: Measures are discretionary ('may decide one or more'); a correction period can defer them (Art. 11).

original_interpretation: Chinese firms needing to trade with a UEL-banned entity must apply to the working mechanism office.
evidence_found: Art. 12: "有关外国实体被限制或者禁止从事与中国有关的进出口活动，中国企业、其他组织或者个人在特殊情况下确需与该外国实体进行交易的，应当向工作机制办公室提出申请，经同意可以与该外国实体进行相应的交易。"

original_interpretation: Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law (10 June 2021): countermeasure list; asset freezes, visa denial, transaction bans.
evidence_found: "（2021年6月10日第十三届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十九次会议通过）"; Art. 4: "国务院有关部门可以决定将直接或者间接参与制定、决定、实施本法第三条规定的歧视性限制措施的个人、组织列入反制清单。" Art. 6: "（一）不予签发签证、不准入境…（二）查封、扣押、冻结在我国境内的动产、不动产和其他各类财产；（三）禁止或者限制我国境内的组织、个人与其进行有关交易、合作等活动"
notes: Law effective on promulgation (Art. 16). Art. 5 extends measures to relatives, senior managers and controlled entities of listed parties.

original_interpretation: AFSL Art. 12 bars implementing/assisting foreign discriminatory measures; affected Chinese parties may sue for injunction and damages.
evidence_found: "第十二条 任何组织和个人均不得执行或者协助执行外国国家对我国公民、组织采取的歧视性限制措施。组织和个人违反前款规定，侵害我国公民、组织合法权益的，我国公民、组织可以依法向人民法院提起诉讼，要求其停止侵害、赔偿损失。"

original_interpretation: Announcement 2023 No. 23: 8 gallium items and 6 germanium items subject to export licensing.
evidence_found: "一、满足以下特性的物项，未经许可，不得出口：（一）镓相关物项。1.金属镓…2.氮化镓…3.氧化镓…4.磷化镓…5.砷化镓…6.铟镓砷…7.硒化镓…8.锑化镓…（二）锗相关物项。1.金属锗…2.区熔锗锭…3.磷锗锌…4.锗外延生长衬底…5.二氧化锗…6.四氯化锗"
notes: Notice itself was repealed on 1 Dec 2024 (Ann. 2024 No. 51, Attachment 2 item 7) with items carried into the unified dual-use list; claim describes the 2023 notice and remains accurate as history.

original_interpretation: Ga/Ge controls issued 3 July 2023, effective 1 Aug 2023.
evidence_found: "【发文日期】2023年07月03日" ... "八、本公告自2023年8月1日起正式实施。" (signed 商务部 海关总署 2023年7月3日)

original_interpretation: Announcement 2023 No. 39 (20 Oct 2023): licences from 1 Dec 2023 for high-purity/strength/density synthetic graphite and natural flake graphite; other graphite items' temporary controls lifted.
evidence_found: "（一）高纯度（纯度>99.9%)、高强度（抗折强度>30Mpa）、高密度（密度>1.73克/立方厘米）的人造石墨材料及其制品…（二）天然鳞片石墨及其制品（包含球化石墨、膨胀石墨等）"; "二、除上述物项外，…2006年第50号…中其他物项取消临时出口管制。"; "九、本公告自2023年12月1日起正式实施"
notes: Synthetic graphite must meet all three thresholds. The 2006 No. 50 notice was repealed the same day.

original_interpretation: Antimony and superhard material controls (2024 No. 33) announced 15 Aug 2024, effective 15 Sept 2024.
evidence_found: "2024年8月15日，商务部、海关总署联合发布公告，决定对部分锑、超硬材料相关物项实施出口管制，自2024年9月15日起正式实施。" (China Export Control Information explainer, first paragraph)
notes: Checked against MOFCOM's own explainer, not the announcement text. 2024 No. 33 was repealed 1 Dec 2024 into the unified list (SRC-0443 item 11).

original_interpretation: MOFCOM explainer lists semiconductor components among antimony's uses and calls superhard materials indispensable for electronic-information industries.
evidence_found: "锑现已被广泛用于各种阻燃剂、合金、陶瓷、玻璃、颜料、半导体元件、电池技术、医药及化工等领域。"; superhard materials are "…光伏与电子信息等战略性新兴产业中不可或缺的高功能材料。"
notes: reported_claim is the right type (government's own justification for controls).

original_interpretation: Unified Dual-Use List effective 1 Dec 2024 (2024 No. 51); 11 notices repealed incl. 2023 No. 23, 2023 No. 39 and 2024 No. 33.
evidence_found: "现公布《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》（见附件1），自2024年12月1日起实施。同日，商务部、海关总署公告2003年第5号…等11个公告（见附件2）废止"; Attachment 2: "七、…2023年第23号（《关于对镓、锗相关物项实施出口管制的公告》）；八、…2023年第39号…；十一、…2024年第33号（《关于对锑等物项实施出口管制的公告》）。"
notes: Ann. 2024 No. 51 is a four-department announcement (MOFCOM, MIIT, GACC, State Cryptography Administration).

original_interpretation: Announcement 2024 No. 46 (3 Dec 2024): dual-use exports to US military users/uses banned; Ga/Ge/Sb/superhard exports to US in principle not licensed; stricter graphite review.
evidence_found: "一、禁止两用物项对美国军事用户或军事用途出口。二、原则上不予许可镓、锗、锑、超硬材料相关两用物项对美国出口；对石墨两用物项对美国出口，实施更严格的最终用户和最终用途审查。" (effective on publication, 2024-12-03)
notes: Accurate as a description of the Dec 2024 measure. Currency: paragraph 2 was suspended by MOFCOM Announcement 2025 No. 72 "自即日起至2026年11月27日" (SRC-0458, recorded as CLM-1385); paragraph 1 (military ban) remains. Atlas prose should not present paragraph 2 as currently applied.

original_interpretation: Announcement 2024 No. 46: organisations/individuals in any country transferring covered Chinese-origin items to US parties will be held liable.
evidence_found: "任何国家和地区的组织和个人，违反上述规定，将原产于中华人民共和国的相关两用物项转移或提供给美国的组织和个人，将依法追究法律责任。"
notes: The sentence follows paragraph 2 and refers to 'the above provisions'; with paragraph 2 suspended until 27 Nov 2026 (Ann. 2025 No. 72), it is unclear whether this liability clause still bites beyond paragraph 1. Not resolved by the sources.

original_interpretation: Announcement 2025 No. 10 (4 Feb 2025, effective on issuance): W, Te, Bi, Mo, In controls incl. InP, TMIn, TEIn.
evidence_found: "【发文日期】2025年02月04日"; "五、铟相关物项（一）3C004.a．磷化铟…（二）3C004.b．三甲基铟…（三）3C004.c．三乙基铟…（四）3E004 生产3C004项的技术及资料"; "本公告自发布之日起正式实施。"
notes: Also covers related production technology (e.g. 3E004); the unified list was updated accordingly.

original_interpretation: Announcement 2025 No. 18 (4 Apr 2025, effective on issuance): seven medium/heavy rare earths (Sm, Gd, Tb, Dy, Lu, Sc, Y) incl. metals, alloys, targets, oxides, compounds.
evidence_found: "[Date of Issuance] April 4, 2025"; sections "I．Samarium related items … II．Gadolinium … III．Terbium … IV．Dysprosium … V．Lutetium … VI．Scandium … VII．Yttrium related items"; "This announcement shall come into effect on the date of issuance."
notes: Checked against MOFCOM's English version, which states it is for reference only (Chinese authentic). Sm, Tb and Dy also cover permanent-magnet materials.

original_interpretation: The April 2025 rare-earth controls cover sputtering targets under reference customs code 8486909110, a code for parts of semiconductor-manufacturing machinery.
evidence_found: SRC-0448: "Terbium-containing targets (Reference customs codes: 3824999922, 8486909110): a. Terbium target; b. Terbium-cobalt alloy target" (same codes for Sm, Gd, Dy, Lu, Sc, Y targets). Junzejun law firm (2025-05-23) table: "8486909110 | 两用物项管制的带背板的溅射靶材组件 | 13% | 3" and "84869091 | 带背板的溅射靶材组件".
correction: Targets for all seven rare earths are listed under two reference codes, 3824999922 and 8486909110. Per a law-firm source, 8486909110 is the line for dual-use-controlled sputtering target assemblies with backing plates within 84869091; see superseding claims in this batch.
notes: The announcement lists the targets under 3824999922 and 8486909110 but does not describe the code; the 'parts of semiconductor machinery' gloss was the researcher's. A secondary (tier-3) law-firm source describes 8486909110 as dual-use-controlled sputtering target assemblies with backing plates (licence condition 3).

original_interpretation: MOFCOM opened anti-dumping investigation into US analog chips on 13 Sept 2025 after petition filed 23 July 2025 by Jiangsu Semiconductor Industry Association.
evidence_found: "商务部…于2025年7月23日收到江苏省半导体行业协会（以下称申请人）代表国内相关模拟芯片产业正式提交的反倾销调查申请" ... "商务部决定自2025年9月13日起对原产于美国的进口相关模拟芯片进行反倾销立案调查。" (Ann. 2025 No. 27)

original_interpretation: Scope: commodity interface ICs (CAN, RS-485, I2C, digital isolators) and gate driver ICs on 40 nm or older, incl. wafers/dies, tariff line 85423990.
evidence_found: "相关模拟芯片中使用40nm及以上工艺制程的通用接口芯片（Commodity Interface IC Chip）和栅极驱动芯片（Gate Driver IC Chip）"; interface types 1-4: CAN (ISO11898), RS485 (TIA/EIA-485), I2C, digital isolator (IEC 60747-5-2); "包括成品芯片及可用来生产相同功能芯片的晶圆、晶粒"; "该产品归在《中华人民共和国进出口税则》：85423990。"
notes: Gate drivers: low-side, half-bridge/multi-channel, isolated. Scope also includes 'future products with the same function'. Other products under 85423990 are excluded.

original_interpretation: Dumping investigation period CY2024; injury period 2022-2024.
evidence_found: "本次调查确定的倾销调查期为2024年1月1日至2024年12月31日，产业损害调查期为2022年1月1日至2024年12月31日。" (Section 1)

original_interpretation: Analog chip AD investigation normally due by 13 Sept 2026, extendable by six months (to 13 March 2027).
evidence_found: "九、调查期限 本次调查自2025年9月13日起开始，通常应在2026年9月13日前结束调查，特殊情况下可延长6个月。" (Section 9)
notes: 13 March 2027 arithmetic is correct. Currency (checked 2026-10-01): the normal deadline has passed, yet neither the TRB notice list (paged back to 2023-06) nor the 2026 announcement list (latest 2026-09-22) shows an extension, ruling or termination. The White House fact sheet (SRC-0477, Nov 2025) says China would terminate anti-dumping investigations targeting US semiconductor firms; no MOFCOM termination notice found.

original_interpretation: Anti-discrimination investigation (13 Sept 2025, Foreign Trade Law Arts 7, 36-37) into US IC measures: s301 tariffs, Oct 2022/Oct 2023/Dec 2024/Jan 2025 export rules, CHIPS Act, May 2025 Huawei Ascend guidance.
evidence_found: "依据《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第三十六条、第三十七条规定，商务部决定自2025年9月13日起就美国被调查措施启动反歧视调查。"; "（一）2018年以来…301调查…加征关税"; "如2022年10月、2023年10月、2024年12月、2025年1月等发布的规则"; "（三）…《芯片与科学法》"; "（四）2025年5月…限制使用包括华为昇腾芯片在内的中国先进计算集成电路"
notes: Art. 7 is cited as the substantive basis, Arts 36-37 as procedural. Scope also includes 'other' US discriminatory measures across the IC chain.

original_interpretation: Anti-discrimination investigation normally three months, extendable.
evidence_found: "三、调查期限 本次调查自2025年9月13日开始，调查期限通常为3个月，特殊情况下可适当延长。"
notes: No determination or extension notice for this case appears in the 2026 announcement list as of 2026-10-01; outcome undocumented in MOFCOM lists.

original_interpretation: TRB issued analog-chip questionnaires Oct 2025; no later milestone in TRB list or 2026 announcement list as of 1 Oct 2026.
evidence_found: TRB list (browser, paged 12 pages back to 2023-06-19): only "关于发放相关模拟芯片反倾销案调查问卷的通知[2025-10-22]" and "商务部公告2025年第27号 公布对原产于美国的进口相关模拟芯片发起反倾销立案调查[2025-09-13]"; latest entry "关于2026年度牛肉保障措施执行提示信息（九）[2026-09-30]". 2026 announcement list (latest 2026-09-22) has no analog-chip item.
notes: Questionnaire notice (商救济进二函〔2025〕26号, 2025-10-22) also opened directly; 37-day response window. Absence-in-list caveat stands: termination could have been published elsewhere, but none found via search either.

original_interpretation: Ann. 2025 No. 61 (9 Oct 2025): foreign exporters need Chinese licence for foreign-made listed items with >=0.1% value of Chinese-origin listed rare earths; part due 1 Dec 2025.
evidence_found: "（一）含有、集成或者混有原产于中国的本公告附件1第一部分所列物项在境外制造的本公告附件1第二部分所列物项，且附件1第一部分所列物项占…价值比例达到0.1%及以上的"; "八、本公告'一（一）'和'一（二）'部分自2025年12月1日起实施。" Ann. 2025 No. 70: "自即日起至2026年11月10日，…商务部公告2025年第61号、62号暂停实施。"
correction: Announcement 2025 No. 61 (including the 0.1% de minimis rule) has been suspended since 7 Nov 2025 by MOFCOM/GACC Announcement 2025 No. 70, until 10 Nov 2026; the 1 Dec 2025 start date did not apply (see CLM-1396).
notes: Text of No. 61 verified. But the 1 Dec 2025 start never took effect: all of No. 61 was suspended from 7 Nov 2025 by Ann. 2025 No. 70.

original_interpretation: Ann. 2025 No. 61 would also require licences for foreign-made listed items made with Chinese-origin rare-earth mining/separation/metallurgy/magnet/recycling technology.
evidence_found: "（二）使用原产于中国的稀土开采、冶炼分离、金属冶炼、磁材制造、稀土二次资源回收利用相关技术在境外生产的本公告附件1所列物项"
notes: Conditional 'would' wording is appropriate: No. 61 suspended 7 Nov 2025 to 10 Nov 2026 by Ann. 2025 No. 70 (CLM-1396).

original_interpretation: Ann. 2025 No. 61: case-by-case review for end uses in <=14 nm logic, >=256-layer memory, or related equipment/test equipment/materials.
evidence_found: "四、最终用途为研发、生产14纳米及以下逻辑芯片或者256层及以上存储芯片，以及制造上述制程半导体的生产设备、测试设备和材料，或者研发具有潜在军事用途的人工智能的出口申请，逐案审批。"
